result.scope_note: Per RFC 9110 §7.3.8 and RFC 9112 §4.3.2, a 200 HEAD response MUST NOT include a message body, while a 200 GET response MUST include the full representation as payload. Therefore, any nonempty resource transferred via GET will have body bytes exceeding those of an equivalent HEAD response.
